title: Billing
description: One simple plan with everything included. No per-booking fees, no surprises.

price.note: Everything included for your whole team. VAT included: nothing is added at checkout.

checkout.successBody: Your subscription is active. A receipt is on its way to your inbox.
checkout.pending: Thanks! Your subscription will activate as soon as Stripe confirms the payment, usually within seconds. Refresh if it doesn’t update.
checkout.cancelledBody: No worries, you haven’t been charged.
checkout.cancelledTrialBody: No worries, you haven’t been charged. Your free trial continues as normal.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: Hournook support has suspended this account, so your booking page is offline. Contact support to resolve it. Your data is safe and you can still export it.

ending.title: Your subscription ends on {date}
ending.body: You won’t be charged again. Everything keeps working until then; after that your booking page stops taking new bookings. Changed your mind? You can resume in the billing portal.

trialing.title: You’re subscribed
trialing.body: Your free trial continues until {date}. Your first {price} payment is taken then.

pastDue.title: Your last payment didn’t go through
pastDue.body: Stripe will retry automatically, but please update your payment method before {date} to keep accepting bookings.

trial.title: {count, plural, one {# day left in your free trial} other {# days left in your free trial}}
trial.body: Your trial ends on {date}. Subscribe any time. If there are more than two days left, they carry over and your first payment is taken when the trial ends.

overdue.title: Your booking page has paused new bookings
overdue.body: We couldn’t collect your last payment. Update your payment method and settle the open invoice to reopen online booking straight away. Nothing has been deleted.

canceled.title: Your subscription has ended
canceled.body: Your booking page isn’t taking new bookings. All your data is still here. Subscribe again to reopen it instantly.

noPlan.title: Your free trial has ended
noPlan.body: Your booking page isn’t taking new bookings right now, but everything you set up is still here. Subscribe to reopen it instantly.
noPlan.bodyEnded: It ended on {date}. Your booking page isn’t taking new bookings right now, but everything you set up is still here. Subscribe to reopen it instantly.

notConfigured.title: Billing isn’t set up on this server yet
notConfigured.bodyTrial: Online payments haven’t been configured for this Hournook installation, so subscriptions can’t be started or changed here. Your free trial keeps working as described above.
notConfigured.bodyAccount: Online payments haven’t been configured for this Hournook installation, so subscriptions can’t be started or changed here. Your account keeps working as described above.

ownerOnly: Only the business owner can subscribe, change the payment method or cancel.

cta.secure: You’ll pay securely on Stripe’s checkout page and come straight back here.
cta.secureHere: You’ll pay securely with Stripe, without leaving this page.

included.title: What’s included
included.page: Your own booking page, QR code & website widget
included.team: Your whole team, no per-seat fees
included.calendar: Calendar, availability, holidays and time off

paymentMethod.title: Payment method
paymentMethod.notConfigured: Not available until billing is set up.
paymentMethod.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your card details right now.
paymentMethod.none: No card on file. You’ll add one when you subscribe.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Receipts are also emailed to you after each payment.
invoices.notConfigured: Invoices will appear here once billing is set up.
invoices.unavailableBody: We couldn’t reach Stripe to load your invoices. Try again in a moment; your subscription isn’t affected.
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. They’ll appear here after your first payment.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
goodToKnow.fees: No per-booking fees. One flat price, however busy you get.
goodToKnow.cancel: Cancel anytime. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for.
goodToKnow.vat: VAT included. The price already includes Greek VAT (24%), so nothing is added on top.
goodToKnow.data: Your data stays yours. If your plan lapses, nothing is deleted. You can still sign in and export.

stripeUnreachable: We couldn’t reach Stripe. Check your connection and try again.
